paragraphs: Continental Utility Solutions, Inc., known as CUSI, has spent decades building utility management software. The line runs from customer information systems and utility billing applications to mobile meter reading and customer web portals.

Billing comes in two forms: UMS, installed on premise, and UB4, a hosted application. The customer web portal gives residents tools to view usage history and financial activity rather than only a place to pay a bill. Mobile meter reading runs on any phone, tablet, or device with a modern internet browser, reading meters and uploading usage data wirelessly back to the billing software. Service orders can be handled from any modern internet-enabled device.

The company states that its products are PCI and FIPS compliant. Support is available by telephone, email, and online chat from 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM Central, Monday through Friday. CUSI says it implements around 70 clients each year. A free web-based learning platform called CUSI Academy provides access to over 100 learning modules.
